ITEM 1 | Pale tan to golden-brown shredded or flaked pieces with fibrous, stringy texture, some edges browned and crisp, glossy sauce residue pooled in spots, sitting on the left-center of the plate in a mound roughly 12 x 9 cm, about 3 cm tall at the thickest point | 190
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown and cream-colored chunks with a slightly crumbly, cooked surface, some darker browned edges and bits of green herb flecks, piled at the top-center of the plate near the first item, roughly 8 x 5 cm, about 2 cm tall | 85
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets with darker charred tips and a slightly glossy, oily sheen, clustered at the upper right of the plate, roughly 7 x 6 cm, about 2.5 cm tall | 60
ITEM 4 | Small roasted brussels sprouts, olive-green to dark brown with charred, blistered outer leaves and a soft interior, halved pieces showing cut faces, sitting beside the broccoli at the top right, roughly 6 x 4 cm, about 2.5 cm tall | 50
ITEM 5 | Thin, bright green whole green beans with slight wrinkling and a matte surface, lying in a loose diagonal bundle across the lower right of the plate, roughly 12 x 5 cm, under 1 cm tall | 45
ITEM 6 | Glossy brown-tan sauce residue with a thin, watery film pooled around the base of the first food mound and along the plate surface, a few small streaks, roughly 8 x 4 cm, flat and thin | 15
